NVJOB Water Shaders V2.0
Author: Nicholas Veselov / #NVJOB
https://github.com/nvjob/nvjob-water-shaders-v2
Source commit: 34f30d75568b2a6828f769f20ee007eb6700fc98
License: MIT. See LICENSE.txt, license_nvjob.txt, and license_unity.txt.

Selected shader sources, the editor inspector and its runtime type dependency,
and two normal maps preserve their upstream GUIDs.
Local PC VR patch: NvWaters.cginc declares the camera depth texture through
UNITY_DECLARE_DEPTH_TEXTURE so instanced stereo can use a texture array.
Both water shaders target shader model 3.5 for those arrays. Other shader code,
the C# sources and the textures remain unchanged. Headset validation is pending.
Demo scenes, environment models, post-processing copies and example prefabs
are omitted. NVWaterShaders is not attached to any project object. The project
water system drives the shader movement and preserves camera depth modes;
no extra planar reflection cameras are used.
